text_block_list.text:
Before practice, I spotted Tamamo Cross.
She seemed to be sniffling, though...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"A-Ah... what's this now?
Could it be hay fever! That's weird, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! This, right!
It's tissue paper! You blow your nose like this...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y-You huge idiot!
I won't forgive ya if you do somethin' like that!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Aww, don't be so mean!
I was just readin' some fan mail!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "The sight of Tama-chan leaving those larger umamusume in the dust like a flash of lightning..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Watching you gives me courage,"
they said. Hearing something like that
really touches your heart, you know...?
